data.description: 美羽在窗边坐下，将点好的饮料放在桌上，望了一会儿外面的街道。
data.action: sitting beside the window with a drink on the table
data.promptProse: Sitting by a panoramic glass window at a quiet seaside cliff cafe, Miu holds a glass of iced berry tea with a straw, watching white sailboats glide across the sparkling blue ocean below. The bright Mediterranean daylight reflects off the white tabletop and ocean swells, while gentle sea breezes flutter the terrace curtains behind her.
